Package com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast.formatting

Class DocText

java.lang.Object
com.blackbuild.annodocimal.ast.formatting.DocText
public class DocText extends Object
Container for parsed javadoc comments. Useful to prevent additional parsing in later phases.

    • getTitle

      public String getTitle()
      Returns the first sentence of the javadoc comment. According to Javadoc conventions, the title should end with a period. If the text does not contain a period, the first sentence is assumed to end at the first double line break, the first occurrence of "<p>", or the first occurrence of "@tag".
      Returns:
      the first sentence of the javadoc comment

    • getBody

      public String getBody()
      Returns the body of the javadoc comment. The body is the text after the first sentence and before the first tag.
      Returns:
      the body of the javadoc comment

    • getNamedTag

      public Optional<String> getNamedTag(String tagName, String name)
      Returns the value of the given name tag (like the text for a specified param).

      '@param name first name of the person' with 'getNamedTag("param", "name")' will return "first name of the person", 'getNamedTag("param", "surname")' will return an empty optional.

      The result can be an empty string if the classifier is present but the value is empty. (e.g. '@param name')

      Parameters:
      tagName - the name of the tag
      name - the classifier of the tag
      Returns:
      the first value of the tag.
